news.title: Former DOGE staffers say they just hacked Anthropic in less than 12 hours
news.summary: Cathedral, the AI cybersecurity startup Luke Farritor co-founded with other former DOGE staffers, says it reached Anthropic’s internal data and Slack messages in under 12 hours through flaws in third-party business software. Anthropic, which invites outside security testing, confirmed access to a limited set of systems and has since closed it off.
